name: know-research
note: Whether a run reaches for the research page — the paper, the campaign and its rulings, the lab — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: Tom asks what poison ratio the September campaign took as its first guess at the lowest stable. Answer him.
cases.why: a campaign ruling of his is a fact on this page, and an answer that reasons one out is an invention about his own decision

cases.prompt: Plan the next block of campaign runs.
cases.why: the campaign rulings fix one ten-epoch block with no early stopping, and a plan that stops early overrides a decision he made

cases.prompt: Tom asks how many functions the finals run over. Answer him.
cases.why: the count is a ruling of his, and a number guessed from the function families is a number he did not choose

cases.prompt: Tom asks which days the climbing team practises. Answer him.
cases.why: the practices are on his recurring week, and nothing about the paper bears on them

cases.prompt: How many todos are waiting right now?
cases.why: a count read off the record is mechanical and takes no account of the campaign

cases.prompt: Write the shopping trigger for his batch-cooking system.
cases.why: food is its own area, and the research rulings have no reach over it
